setting.sl: V ambulanti (Ordination) splošnega zdravnika v sosednji vasi. Že tri dni te bolita grlo in glava. Zdravnik te prosi za kartico zdravstvenega zavarovanja (e-card).
setting.en: At the family doctor's practice (an Ordination, as Austrians say) in the next village. You have had a sore throat and a headache for three days. The doctor asks for your health insurance card, the e-card.
setting.it: Nell'ambulatorio (Ordination, come dicono in Austria) del medico di famiglia, nel paese vicino. Da tre giorni hai mal di gola e mal di testa. Il medico ti chiede la tessera sanitaria, la e-card.

role: Dr. Wieser, a calm family doctor (Allgemeinmediziner) in the next village. Speaks slowly and clearly, one simple question at a time; says it is a cold, nothing serious. Austrian German: Ordination, e-card, Halsweh. Says Sie to {learner}.
